# 第三方配置指南

以下配置直接填写在 `src/main/resources/application.yml` 的 `hospital` 节点下，包含阿里云短信、支付宝沙箱和阿里云 OSS。

## 阿里云短信

```yaml
sms:
  enabled: true
  code-expire-seconds: 300
  code-length: 6
  access-key-id: 'LTAI5t9zcDYGLizFQsoFe9Hq'
  access-key-secret: 'MVufsimSYJRC1JBW0sJpEuLPIk8Jxz'
  endpoint: 'dypnsapi.aliyuncs.com'
  sign-name: '速通互联验证码'
  template-code: '100001'
```

## 支付宝沙箱

```yaml
alipay:
  enabled: true
  mock-enabled: false
  gateway: 'https://openapi-sandbox.dl.alipaydev.com/gateway.do'
  seller-id: '2088721111952876'
  app-id: '9021000168601239'
  app-private-key: ''
  alipay-public-key: ''
  notify-url: ''
  return-url: 'http://localhost:8080/api/pay/alipay/return'
```

## 阿里云 OSS

```yaml
oss:
  enabled: true
  endpoint: 'https://oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com'
  access-key: 'LTAI5t9zcDYGLizFQsoFe9Hq'
  secret-key: 'MVufsimSYJRC1JBW0sJpEuLPIk8Jxz'
  bucket: 'sk-itcase'
```

修改完成后重启后端，使配置生效。
